nidhāna.cp: neut. a deposit; a hidden treasure.
nidhāna.p: [Ni+dhā+yu.(nidhāna-saṃ] (na) CL=9 Ṇidhāṇa, ṇihāṇa-prā)] (1) to store, keep. (a) to bury. (b) dedication. (c) collection. (d) to put, place. (2) to take care, look after. (3) to attend, feed up. (4) the place of gathering (of food); stomach. (5) storage place. mind, Manodvāra. (6) Stored, buried, collected treasure / wealth. (7) existing collectively.(three genders) (8) (morality etc.,) that looks like stored, buried, collected treasure. (9) stored, buried, collected. (the pot of gold called Saṅkha, padma, the place, Cintāmaṇi, the place in which something is kept , the coffer, the residence.)
